observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.

claims.claim: No, I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true.
claims.evidence: Seller’s statement is not supported by any new photo/video showing the chair’s mechanisms or upholstery condition.
Photo 0 does not show close-up upholstery details; small stains/tears could be hidden by angle/lighting.
Foam firmness cannot be confirmed from photo 0.
Smoke odor cannot be verified remotely from photo 0.

risks.risk: The chair may still have a bent/misaligned frame or base that affects comfort/stability, even if the seller claims it was tested.
risks.proof: A short video showing the chair from front and side while standing on the floor, plus a close-up of the base/under-seat frame for any bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used office chair with possible frame issue (worst case: not fully straight/needs repair).

risks.risk: Upholstery may have small stains, fraying, or tears not visible in photo 0.
risks.proof: Close-up photos in bright light of seat top, seat edges/underside, backrest corners, and armrest pads.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having unknown upholstery condition (worst case: minor stains/wear).

risks.risk: Mechanisms may not work reliably (height adjustment, tilt/lock), or may fail under load.
risks.proof: Video demonstrating height lift and tilt/lock/unlock, plus a clip showing casters rolling smoothly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested (worst case: may need servicing).

risks.risk: Foam may be sagging under weight even if it looks okay from one angle.
risks.proof: Video of someone sitting and standing (showing bounce/sag) and a close-up of seat thickness.
risks.if_unproven: Price as foam not guaranteed firm (worst case: some sag).

proof_requests: Send 3 short videos: (1) chair from front showing it sits level, (2) chair from side showing any bend, (3) someone sitting/standing to show foam firmness and stability.
Send a video demonstrating height adjustment and tilt/lock working.
Send close-up photos of upholstery: seat top + edges, backrest corners, and armrest pads (bright light).
Send a close-up of any label/underside tag for brand/model (if present).
response.reason: The seller’s claim of testing is not verifiable without new clips/photos showing the chair level, upholstery condition, and that the mechanisms work under load. Request the specific videos/clips to price confidently.
